proof_body:
by
  intro a w hw
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hw' : (w : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hw
  have hc : ((-2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
    push_cast
    simp [hw', hpi]
  have e : ∀ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Complex.exp ((((-2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * v) := by
    intro v; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  simp only [e]
  rw [integral_exp_mul_complex hc]
  have h1 : ((-2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I * (a : ℂ) = ((-(2 * Real.pi * a * w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by push_cast; ring
  have h2 : ((-2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I * ((-a : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((2 * Real.pi * a * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by push_cast; ring
  rw [h1, h2, Complex.exp_mul_I, Complex.exp_mul_I, Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.cos_neg, Complex.sin_neg]
  rw [Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_sin]
  have hI := Complex.I_ne_zero
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring_nf
target_source: ∀ a w : ℝ, w ≠ 0 → ∫ v in (-a)..a, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = ((Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * a * w) / (Real.pi * w) : ℝ) : ℂ)
